public_rationale: The forecast is conditional and has no deadline. The pipeline report establishes announced capacity, not the sustained demand shortfall needed to activate the forecast. No decisive cohort-wide collapse was established either. Because the antecedent remains unknown, the conditional-forecast rule requires not_adjudicable at this freeze. The absence of widespread defaults so far is not a failed prediction.
limitations: This is a timing and evidence finding, not a conclusion that the forecast can never be tested.
Capacity, annual revenue and the capital cost of construction cannot be compared without an economic model.
Project delays and failures in adjacent industries do not automatically count as AI data center collapses.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If AI compute demand does not exist at this remarkable scale, the vast majority of AI data centers and their associated SPVs will collapse.
conditions: if the demand does not exist at this remarkable scale

statement.excerpt: Putting aside whether data centers are profitable or not (they aren’t), if the demand does not exist at this remarkable scale, the vast majority of AI data centers and their associated SPVs will collapse.

from_speaker: if the demand does not exist at this remarkable scale
AI data centers and their associated SPVs
190GW of data center capacity in planning
our_interpretation: Assess the conditional forecast, not the parenthetical assertion about current profitability.
The condition is a sustained shortfall in paying AI compute demand relative to the buildout described in the post.
Collapse means insolvency, financial default or permanent closure for financial reasons. A delay or an unbuilt proposal alone does not qualify.
Vast majority means an overwhelming majority of the relevant projects and associated financing vehicles, not merely several prominent failures.
No deadline is supplied. The screens' suggested annual demand figure is not substituted for a threshold explicitly stated in the supplied passage.
The conditional-forecast rule takes precedence: an unknown antecedent makes the forecast not adjudicable at this freeze.
criteria.support_condition: The demand-shortfall condition is established and a representative record shows an overwhelming majority of the relevant AI data centers and associated SPVs subsequently collapse.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The demand-shortfall condition is established and the relevant project cohort completes its economic and financing life without the predicted widespread collapse.

evidence.excerpt: We’re tracking 190GW across 777 large data centers and AI factories (>50MW) announced since 2024.
evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning the quantitative pipeline discussion
evidence.explanation: This establishes the scope of the announced pipeline cited in the post. Announced electrical capacity does not establish realized paying demand or show that the forecast's condition has occurred.

evidence.excerpt: No neocloud has publicly defaulted on a GPU-backed loan as of October 2026.
evidence.locator: GPU default questions, answer to 'Which GPU companies have defaulted?'
evidence.explanation: The compilation does not identify the forecast's widespread collapse. Its negative finding is limited to public GPU-backed loan defaults and cannot disprove an open-ended forecast.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Establish sustained insufficient paying demand for a defined buildout cohort, then track that cohort's financial outcomes until widespread failure or successful completion decisively meets the stated resolution rule.
